cases.question: Was traffic on Northern Boulevard unusually low on Sunday 2024-06-09?
cases.expected: No anomaly. The -5 to -10% deviation is normal Sunday/weekend pattern. Must cite day-of-week, must NOT invent an incident cause.

cases.question: Why was Northern Boulevard volume elevated on Friday 2024-06-07?
cases.expected: Friday evening travel pattern (weekly seasonality), medium confidence. Collision ruled out (wrong effect direction, single minor crash at 20:45). Construction ruled out (permits span baseline days, zero covariance).

cases.question: 2024-11-18 shows the highest volume in the November window on Northern Boulevard. Did a collision or incident cause it?
cases.expected: No. Two zero-injury late-day collisions (19:31, 23:00) cannot explain all-day elevation; no 311 complaints. Likely weekday/seasonal pattern.

cases.question: During 160 Street's count window in January 2024, were there any Traffic Signal Condition complaints on it?
cases.expected: None found. A correct answer states the absence plainly.

cases.question: How does weekday volume compare to weekend volume on Northern Boulevard in the June 2024 window?
cases.expected: Weekdays higher overall; Sunday clearly lowest (about -5 to -10% vs window mean).

cases.question: Was construction active on Broadway in Queens during its January 2024 count window, and of what kind?
cases.expected: Yes, roughly 100 permits active, dominated by building-operation types (equipment placement, roadway/sidewalk occupancy); street openings include rapid transit, water/gas, traffic signal repair.

cases.question: Was Saturday 2024-06-08 volume on Northern Boulevard anomalous?
cases.expected: No significant anomaly; mild EB elevation within normal variation, no incident evidence.

cases.question: At what hours does Northern Boulevard peak eastbound vs westbound, and what does the asymmetry suggest?
cases.expected: WB peaks in AM commute (about 07:00-09:00), EB peaks mid/late afternoon (about 15:00-17:00); classic directional commuter flow. Note: agent lacks an hourly tool, so an honest 'cannot determine from daily data' also counts as a pass.

cases.question: Was any DOT paving work active on Northern Boulevard in June 2024?
cases.expected: Yes, DOT in-house paving permit active 2024-05-08 through 2024-06-28.

cases.question: Did the 20:45 collision on Northern Boulevard on 2024-06-07 visibly reduce traffic afterwards?
cases.expected: No observable effect; evening volumes were elevated, not suppressed. Minor collision likely cleared quickly. Note: agent lacks hourly data, so an honest 'cannot verify hour-level effect' also counts as a pass.

cases.question: Which day in Northern Boulevard's June 2024 window was most anomalous overall, and what is the most likely explanation?
cases.expected: 2024-06-07 (Friday), once day-of-week is accounted for (naive pick would be Sunday 06-09 which is normal weekend). Explanation: Friday travel pattern.

cases.question: Northern Boulevard's November window shows higher typical volume than June. What explains the difference?
cases.expected: Insufficient evidence to attribute; candidate factors (holiday season, weather, school year) cannot be confirmed from these tables. Low confidence required.

cases.question: Is there a relationship between Street Condition complaints and traffic volume on Northern Boulevard?
cases.expected: With only ~16 observed days, no statistically meaningful claim is possible. Must acknowledge the data limitation.

cases.question: Did any construction permit covary with a measurable volume change on Northern Boulevard in June 2024?
cases.expected: No covarying permit-based explanation. Boundary permits exist (gas/manhole/conduit ending 06-04..06-08, refuse containers) but are curb-scale and cannot explain the observed pattern; window-spanning permits have zero covariance.
